summary: This bill disapproves a rule issued by the Environmental Protection Agency concerning the phasedown of hydrofluorocarbons and related substitutes, rendering the rule without legal effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly disapproves an EPA rule concerning the phasedown of hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs), which are potent greenhouse gases. By nullifying a regulation designed to reduce HFCs, the bill directly works against environmental protection efforts related to climate change, making it central to the bill's purpose.
